Strength and cross-training log

Log sets, loads, reps and optional RPE from 150 generic exercises sorted by muscle group, and workouts in AMRAP, EMOM, For Time or interval format with their score. Weekly volume, sets per muscle group, personal records detected automatically (estimated 1RM with the Epley formula, shown as an estimate), progress curves and an offline timer. Performance data only, no health data. Not a training programme or medical advice.
